untiled._caveat: position/size errors exclude the 'shopname' role - validate_all.py's greedy nearest-centre matcher can cross-pair Agarpathi's two separate shopname text objects (Tamil + English, at very different page positions), confirmed on the master-regenerated-as-itself sanity check (every other of 29 matched objects differed by 0.0mm, but shopname alone showed a ~1600mm 'error' equal to the real distance between the two text boxes - a matching artifact, not a placement error). This is a tooling gap in validate_all.py, not fixed here; shopname accuracy itself is unmeasured by these bounds and content_check.py's exact-text check remains the only verified signal for it. Even excluding shopname, error here is large (median ~380mm) - the generic per-object scale+centre engine does not reproduce Agarpathi's real hand-placed logo positions well across this landscape sample, unlike dalmia's much smaller untiled median (~116-139mm).
